name: Adult Children
overview: Scripture teaches that adult children have a God-ordained place within the family structure, emphasizing both honor and responsibility. They are called to honor their parents as commanded in Exodus 20:12, while also recognizing the biblical principle that a man leaves his parents to unite with his wife (Genesis 2:24). The value of children as a heritage from the Lord (Psalms 127:3) is affirmed alongside the importance of parental instruction and discipline (Proverbs 1:8; 13:24). Furthermore, the mutual blessing between generations is highlighted, with children bringing glory to their fathers and grandchildren being a crown to the elderly (Proverbs 17:6).
